summary: Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Q1 2026 results and a newly authorized share repurchase program of up to $100.0 million in Class A common stock, to expire June 30, 2028. Repurchases may occur on the open market or in private transactions under Rule 10b-18, at management's discretion with no obligation to buy any specific amount. No premium, price per share, or advisor was named. The program is purely discretionary and can be modified or suspended anytime. Watch for actual execution pace and market reaction to the buyback authorization as a signal of management's capital allocation priorities.
